payload.question: 上月各大区成交额从高到低排一下

metrics.label: GMV
metrics.description: 已支付订单的实付金额合计。包含之后整单退款的订单，不包含已取消（未支付）订单。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），GMV最高的区域是华东（13.36 万元），最低的是东北（2.34 万元）。

queries.title: GMV
queries.sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    region_name
  FROM regions
) AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
